summary.name: Slack for Mac
summary.one_liner: Slack's macOS desktop app for team chat, task tracking and collaboration, available from the Mac App Store.
summary.what_it_does: The page is Slack's download page for its Mac app, which the page describes as combining team chat, task tracking and collaboration tools. It offers the app through the Mac App Store. The page states Slack also works on Windows and Linux. Navigation links point to Enterprise, Pricing, and AI features, but the page text gives no specifics about these. Most of the remaining text is cookie consent information.
notable: Available as a Mac App Store download
